svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.bell-jar-candle-observation-context", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "teaching": "Introduced before/after comparison of a candle flame under a bell jar on a dry plate: initially burning, later extinguished with no free outside-air exchange. Independent dry-apparatus state comparison, not exact native1682reproduction or an actual experiment outcome. Limited enclosed air and altered combustion conditions permit extinction, but do not infer all oxygen consumed, a vacuum or a universal fixed extinguishment time. University Maryland and original chemical-education research explicitly reject equating candle/water rise to complete oxygen removal; this model omits water entirely. Ignition method, heat flow, gas gradients and quantities are not represented. Teacher/audio time/state key required. Apparatus/time programme is one relationship meaning, not two new candle/jar identities.", "geometry_exception": "Native1.2mm graphic dots with3.1mm guard. Continuous4mm sori/junctions and5mm phase badges use one native logical dot each. Junction vertices de-duplicated. Profiles share compatible geometry; no Braille or physical recognition result.", "physical_evaluation": "pending", "arrow_repair": {"source": "BANA2022section3.4.3.7", "construction": "Open equilateral head,12mm sides/base;9mm shaft-to-apex separation gives3.1mm nominal edge clearance for1.4mm strokes. The additional gap protects clear separation at nominal scale; no physical proof claimed.", "old_master": "tactile/masters/education/science/combustion/bell-jar-candle-observation-context.svg", "physical_evaluation": "pending"}}

g.data-exception-reason: Native1.2mm graphic dots with3.1mm guard. Logical root/leaf/wire joints shared once; continuous4mm sori/junctions and5mm phase badges use one native dot at each exact centre. This changes mark diameter, not learned one/two count or logical topology. Optional near-junction samples omitted; no Braille or actual tactile validation.
